operating_notes.text: BWR notes low AT&C losses of ~4% and high collection efficiency in the Asansol-Raniganj distribution business.
Rated facilities: ₹102.83 Cr fund based and ₹4.15 Cr non-fund based, aggregating ₹106.98 Cr.
AT&C losses improved from 4.32% in FY22 to 3.66% in FY26.
HT line consumers contribute approximately 95% of regulated business revenue.
State Bank of India filed a claim of ₹500.48 Cr in the Section 7 IBC petition admitted against DPSC on 15 May 2026.
Chief Business Officer Pramod Singh resigned citing personal and family reasons, accepted by IRP Ms. Sreenivasa Mano Ranjani Medarametla.

timeline.summary: DPSC Limited announced that its RTA CB Management Services merged into MUFG Intime India Private Limited effective May 8, 2026.
On 15 May 2026, NCLT Hyderabad admitted SBI's Section 7 petition for initiating CIRP against India Power Corporation Limited.
DPSC Limited announced the suspension of its board powers following the admission of SBI's CIRP petition by NCLT.

On 22 May 2026, Brickwork Ratings downgraded DPSC Limited's ₹106.98 Cr bank loan facilities to BWR BB/BWR A4 from BWR BBB-/BWR A3, citing NCLT Hyderabad's 15 May 2026 CIRP admission on SBI's petition.
Infomerics Ratings downgraded DPSC Limited's bank facilities to IVR B- (Negative Watch) on 22 May 2026 following its admission into insolvency proceedings.
DPSC Limited postponed its management meeting to approve FY26 results to May 30, 2026, due to lack of quorum from the suspended board under the ongoing insolvency process.
DPSC Limited concluded the postal ballot for the re-appointment of Mr. Anil Kumar Jha as an Independent Director.
NCLT Hyderabad admitted Section 7 IBC application against DPSC on 15 May 2026 on SBI's ₹500.48 Cr claim; FY26 audited accounts approved by RP under qualified opinion.
Chief Business Officer Pramod Singh resigned effective 31 May 2026 amid ongoing insolvency resolution process.
DPSC Limited informed about the 9th CoC meeting for India Power's CIRP on 15th October 2026
